findings.reason: without a same-job A/A check or a shared copy-pair the node cannot show the medians detect the repair rather than the machine's own spread, which is the exact reason §24 carried the control §34 drops.
findings.text: §34 requires five passes per arm but puts each arm in its own exclusive job over its own copies, and its only control is "the before revision still fails the sweep bound"; §24's harness (which §34 says it uses) required both revisions to read one copy-pair made once in the job "so the revisions differ only in code", and §34's own Why records that two copies of one revision disagreed by up to 51.6%, so a head-vs-before gap measured across separate jobs and copies is not separable from machine and corpus noise
